title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
executive_summary: This change fixes a horn state display problem on the brake/horn interface screen for SR-FLRT3-DMU trains, where pressing the Horn key doesn't update the screen to show Active status. The issue is specific to this control type and screen - it doesn't affect the EBI Slot 6 diagnostics screen, the System Test Brakes screen, or SR-KSS_EMU trains. You need to test seven cases across two requirements: start with the two priority P0 tests that directly check horn key behavior on the brake/horn interface screen and horn state when onboard is at cutout for SR-FLRT3-DMU. Then run the five P1 tests covering horn key press and release on the interface screen, cutout behavior on SR-KSS_EMU for comparison, and the diagnostic screen details view. The change affects the Brake System Interface directly and has indirect impact on the Crew Display HMI and Locomotive Interface Gateway.

ecr_overview.title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
ecr_overview.description:
When the Horn key is pressed on the "brake/horn interface" screen, Ob doesn't update the Horn state field to Active, and it continues to show Inactive on the screen.

This is working fine on "EBI Slot 6 - EBI Onboard Diagnostics" and "System Test - Brakes" Screen.

This issue is only observed for SR-FLRT3-DMU. For SR-KSS_EMU, Ob is working correctly.
ecr_overview.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Set control type SR-FLRT3-DMU and bring OB to cutout
2. Open OB diagnostic screen
3. Go to the Brake/Horn interface row and press the show details key
4. Ensure OB displays the Brake/Horn interface screen
5. Press the Horn key
6. Observe OB keep showing Horn state as Inactive
ecr_overview.observed_behavior: On pressing the Horn key, OB keeps showing the Horn state field status as Inactive
ecr_overview.expected_behavior: OB should update the horn state field as Active
